text:
maria.sales: LumenPath RFP arrived — they want a capability matrix, security questionnaire answers, and a two-track POC (private VPC + air-gapped appliance). POC window = 4 weeks. They require customer-managed KMS/HSM and EU data residency (eu-west-1). PDF attached.

devon-se: Got it. Any concurrency / token info? Need to size GPUs and call out perf delta for air-gapped.

maria.sales: LumenPath listed ~220 concurrent sessions peak, avg prompt 70 tokens, avg response 200 tokens. Targets: p50 <= 280ms, p95 <= 650ms.

devon-se: Baseline: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs for dedicated; autoscale to 3-4 for spikes. Air-gapped will likely need higher spec to reliably hit p95. I'll draft the matrix.

leah-ops: We should provide both flows: (1) private VPC deploy (control plane in their VPC), (2) air-gapped appliance image + offline install guide. Teardown + data destruction checklist required.

infra-bot: Compliance quick-check: SOC2-TypeII=yes; ISO27001=partial; FedRAMP=no; KMS-integration=yes; HSM-attestation=partner-certificates-available. See /sales/rfps/templates.

juna-csm: Please lock acceptance criteria before kickoff: perf tests, KMS integration demo, and audit log export verification. Ask the customer to provide written success criteria.

omar-legal: We'll need DPA + air-gap addendum (key custody, support windows, patching responsibilities). Also check for subprocessor disclosure requests.

devon-se: Small CSV snippet for the matrix to include in the response:
```
component,hosted,dedicated,private-vpc,air-gapped
concurrent-sessions,1000,2600,220,220
p50-latency,95ms,80ms,150ms,230ms
p95-latency,430ms,300ms,600ms,820ms
kms-mode,managed,customer,connector,hsm-offline
```

maria.sales: Good. Action items: Devon -> full matrix + 2-page POC runbook (both tracks). Leah -> teardown + SHA256 manifest template + air-gap USB transfer notes. Omar -> DPA redline. I'll schedule kickoff with LumenPath infra for Thurs 10:00 UTC and attach their RFP. Flag blockers ASAP. :thumbsup:
